items.name: Crystal battery (enh)
items.short_description: A battery of increased power. Improves damage and gives weapons ability to burn armor, but a weapon wears out more quickly

items.name: Fuel

items.name: Fuel (opt)
items.short_description: Fuel with special additives that significantly increase the combustion temperature

items.name: Energy cell
items.short_description: A battery used for a star blaster, many times more powerful than usual batteries

items.name: 40-mm shell
items.short_description: A small explosive projectile for use in grenade launchers

items.name: 40-mm shell (plas)
items.short_description: A more powerful magical energy model of grenades

items.name: 40-mm shell (pul)
items.short_description: Grenade with a pulse charge, designed for fighting against robots

items.name: Rocket
items.short_description: A self-propelled projectile for use in rocket launchers

items.name: Balefire egg
items.short_description: A magical projectile, resembling an egg. Destructive energy, hidden deep inside, is expressed on a surface merely by elusive flickering of lights

items.name: Aerosol
items.short_description: A cylinder of liquid propane and isobutane - highly flammable gases

items.name: Dart
items.short_description: A common attribute for a darts game

items.name: Circular saw
items.short_description: A circular saw of stainless steel with sharp teeth

items.name: Acid
items.short_description: A plastic bottle with concentrated acid

items.name: Cryo-cell
items.short_description: If the alchemical compounds contained in this small cell react, this would cause an instant drop in their temperature to the almost absolute zero

items.name: Railway spike
items.short_description: A heavy iron thing, used to attach sleepers to rails

items.name: Dynamite
items.short_description: A simple stick of dynamite with a long fuse, more suitable for mining than fighting. Use with care!

items.name: Hoofmade grenade
items.short_description: A primitive grenade, made of a tin can filled with gunpowder and metal junk. It can be easily created at a workbench

items.name: Incendiary cocktail
items.short_description: A bottle filled with incendiary liquid and plugged with a piece of cloth. Ignite it, throw it - simple, cheap, effective

items.name: Frag grenade
items.short_description: An effective weapon against enemies hiding behind a cover. It looks like a metallic apple

items.name: Gaseous grenade
items.short_description: This grenade emits a cloud of toxic gases. Even small amount of it can cause a quick death when inhaled. Especially effective in small and poorly ventilated rooms

items.name: Acid bomb
items.short_description: A bottle filled with a very corrosive liquid. When smashed, it spills acid everywhere, causing severe chemical burns to whoever steps into it. Effective against robots` armor

items.name: Incendiary grenade
items.short_description: Exploding, this grenade sets everything on fire

items.name: Plasma grenade
items.short_description: Instead of common explosive substances, this grenade uses powerful magic charge that can melt everything! Much more powerful than usual grenades

items.name: Impulse grenade
items.short_description: A grenade using electromagnetic impulse for destroying robots and other electronics. Is not effective against live targets

items.name: Cryogrenade
items.short_description: On explosion, the surrounding air instantly cools down to extremely low temperatures. The living beings receive serious hypothermic damage

items.name: Sparkle-grenade
items.short_description: An extremely powerful version of a hoofmade grenade with increased radius of damage. For an explosive it uses an infernal mixture based on Sparkle-Cola RAD

items.name: Hoofmade mine
items.short_description: A mine assembled from junk and gunpowder. It operates like an ordinary anti-personnel mine, but not as powerful

items.name: Fragmentation mine
items.short_description: A proximity mine, equipped with a friend/enemy recognition system

items.name: Plasma mine
items.short_description: Powerful magically-enhanced version of a usual mine

items.name: Impulse mine
items.short_description: Anti-robot mine, which sensor is calibrated to react only on mechanical enemies. It doesn`t affect live forces

items.name: Cryomine
items.short_description: On explosion of this mine, the surrounding air instantly cools down to extremely low temperatures. The living beings receive serious hypothermic damage

items.name: Zebra`s mine
items.short_description: This mine is more powerful than usual fragmentation and plasma mines, and because of its camouflage pattern it is more difficult to notice. In addition, zebras often cast a curse on such mines, making them even more dangerous

items.name: Balefire mine
items.short_description: A balefire egg, turned into a mine. It is required to be a real explosives master to assemble and use such dangerous devices

items.name: Explosive X-37
items.short_description: Small, yet powerful charges of plastic explosives equipped with a radio detonator. You can install several charges and then explode all at the same time by pressing the button. To detonate, press the reload button [R]. Only explosives in the same room will detonate

items.name: Dynamite pack
items.short_description: A couple of dynamite sticks, held together with duct tape. It is more effective for destroying walls, than ordinary dynamite, but doesn`t cause much damage to fortified concrete

items.name: Hoofmade bomb
items.short_description: Explosives made for destroying fragile walls. More sturdy walls may require a couple of these

items.name: The explosive C-4
items.short_description: It is a very powerful explosive device that can destroy even the sturdiest concrete wall. Useless against steel walls

items.name: Bag with caps
items.short_description: Bottle caps used as money

items.name: Healing potion
items.short_description: Intended for treatment of light injuries. Treatment effect takes some time

items.name: Large healing Potion
items.short_description: Intended for treatment of injuries of medium severity. Treatment effect takes some time

items.name: Extra-strong healing potion
items.short_description: Intended for treatment of severe injuries. Treatment effect takes some time

items.name: RadAway
items.short_description: Clears body of magical radiation

items.name: Charmed bandage
items.short_description: Suitable for treatment of scratches and cuts and also stops bleeding

items.name: Magic potion
items.short_description: Restores magical power and heals magical burnout and exhaustion

items.name: Large magic potion
items.short_description: Restores magical power and heals magical burnout and exhaustion

items.name: Super-large magic potion
items.short_description: Restores magical power and heals magical burnout and exhaustion

items.name: Antidote
items.short_description: Instantly neutralizes effects of any kind of toxins and increases poison resistance for a short time

items.name: First aid kit
items.short_description: Collection of medical supplies necessary to treat light wounds and injuries. Basic medical skills are required to use this item

items.name: Doctor`s bag
items.short_description: A set of medical instruments needed for mending fractured bones and other serious injuries. Advanced medical skills are required to use this item

items.name: Military surgeon`s bag
items.short_description: Contains complex medical tools and healing spells for treating the most severe wounds. One can literally bring somepony back to life with this, providing he has the most advanced medical skills and lots of experience

items.name: Blood pack
items.short_description: A pack of artificial blood, compatible with blood of any pony race

items.name: Detoxin
items.short_description: Rare and valuable medicine used to treat chemical addiction. Instantly removes all drug effects, both positive and negative, and also neutralizes poison

items.name: Rad-X
items.short_description: A substance in capsules of yellow and red colors, temporarily increasing radiation resistance. Recommended when working in places with high magical radiation background. Use one capsule per individual

items.name: Mint-als
items.short_description: Drugs in a form of peppermint-flavored candy. Temporarily gives you a boost to intelligence and clear thinking, and also sharpens your senses, but has reverse, negative after effects

items.name: Party-time Mint-als
items.short_description: Improved version of Mint-als, giving much more prominent effect. Incredibly boosts brain capabilities and sharpness of perception. Effect doesn`t add up with that of common Mint-als

items.name: Dash
items.short_description: A powerful military stimulator, that gives you a feeling of time being slowed down. Increases speed and gives additional action points in S.A.T.S.

items.name: Rage
items.short_description: A drug developed and manufactured during the Great War in order to increase soldiers` courage and aggressiveness. Makes user feel unstoppable rage, resulting in higher amount of damage being caused

items.name: Med-X
items.short_description: A potent pain-killer for intravenous injection. For a short time makes you completely mute to pain, which is sometimes used to increase soldiers` effectiveness in combat

items.name: Stampede
items.short_description: A drug that combines effects of Rage and Med-X. It makes one feel unstoppable rage while simultaneously suppressing any pain and self-protection instinct, making him or her very dangerous and deadly. Not compatible with common Rage or Med-X

items.name: Buck
items.short_description: Steroid drug in form of green pills, used to increase physical strength and endurance. Starts working immediately, although only for a short period of time

items.name: Ultra-dash
items.short_description: An advanced version of the dash, makes user fast as a lightning. True, there is some probability of sudden death from a heart attack. Does not add up with the effect of an ordinary dash

items.name: Hydra
items.short_description: Healing potion of unmatched effectiveness, formulated with essence of an actual hydra. Speeds up living tissue regeneration by up to a hundred times, mending any injuries, but it is also dangerous because of possible mutagenic side effects

items.name: Super-stimulation potion
items.short_description: Instantly restores health. Even though it is capable of saving life in a critical condition, it is very toxic

items.name: Potion of flight
items.short_description: This potion gives you wings, thus making you able to fly. The effect is temporary

items.name: Potion of shadows
items.short_description: Drinking the potion will turn you into a shadow. While in this form, it is hard to see or cause damage to you, but you won`t be able to fight as well. Also, it seems that it weakens unicorns` telekinesis ability

items.name: Wizardry potion
items.short_description: The potion reduces magical energy consumption for telekinesis and different spells, increasing their power, and also speeds up energy restoration

items.name: Infra-vision potion
items.short_description: For a short period of time allows you seeing through walls and also to see things that are hidden or concealed with magic

items.name: Diver`s potion
items.short_description: For five minutes allows you to breathe underwater and swim much faster

items.name: Pink potion
items.short_description: This potion somewhat protects you from the harmful effects of the Pink Cloud

items.name: Potion of the Last Chance
items.short_description: If during its action you are dealt a death blow, you gain absolute protection for 5 seconds and partially restore your health. Absolute protection does not save from poison and bleeding

items.name: Potion of purification
items.short_description: Purifies from curses

items.name: Potion of transformation
items.short_description: Turns you into a small animal for a short time. This potion is so powerful that it`s enough to take just the smallest sip, hence you can use it many times

items.name: Joint of magic weed
items.short_description: Smokable. The effect is unpredictable!

items.name: Potion of fortitude
items.short_description: This potion makes your bones sturdy and capable to endure heavy load. Permanent effect

items.name: Potion of might
items.short_description: This potion improves your reflexes and increases aggression. You can deal more damage with melee weapons. Permanent effect

items.name: Immunity potion
items.short_description: Drinking this improves your ability to resist different negative factors, such as poisoning, bleeding and radiation. Permanent effect

items.name: Potion of vivacity
items.short_description: This potion increases running speed and stamina capacity. In other words you can run faster and longer. Permanent effect

items.name: Potion of concentration
items.short_description: This potion fortifies your nervous system and sharpens sight, which improves your shooting accuracy. Permanent effect

items.name: Elemental potion
items.short_description: A potion invented by unicorns in the distant past. Strengthens magician`s connection to natural forces and increases power of his spells

items.name: Elixir of Intuition
items.short_description: This potion gives you an ability to anticipate the near future to some extent, and thus evade enemy bullets. Permanent effect

items.name: Elixir of Fortune
items.short_description: It is hard to say what exactly this potion does and how it works, but with it your hits will cause critical damage more often. Permanent effect

items.name: Elixir of mind expansion
items.short_description: An incredibly rare elixir, the recipe of which seems to be lost forever. Enhances the magical talent making unicorns capable of holding more spells in memory at the same time. The effect is permanent

items.name: Potion of life
items.short_description: Permanently increases maximum health

items.name: Potion of spirit
items.short_description: Permanently increases the maximum of magical power

items.name: Radioactive cookies
items.short_description: It is extremely not recommended eating this thing. But perhaps there is somepony who might like it

items.name: Sparkle-cola
items.short_description: The most popular alcohol-free fizzy beverage with carrot flavor. Speeds up restoration of magical energy

items.name: Sparkle-Cola RAD
items.short_description: A rare kind of Sparkle-Cola, which contains radioactive substances. Has a radish taste and glows in the dark

items.name: Sunrise Sarsaparilla
items.short_description: Non-alcoholic fizzy drink produced before the War. Restores health

items.name: Coffee
items.short_description: Tasty and healthy drink with a light stimulating effect

items.name: Milk
items.short_description: Fresh brahmin milk, removes radiation

items.name: Beer
items.short_description: Low-alcoholic beverage made from local oats. The taste is not so great

items.name: Home brew
items.short_description: Low-alcohol beverage from potatoes. The taste leaves much to be desired

items.name: Liqueur
items.short_description: Alcoholic drink of medium strength from local fruits, or whatever is now used instead of them. Pretty pleasant to the taste

items.name: Schnapps
items.short_description: A fairly strong alcoholic beverage obtained by distillation

items.name: Moonshine
items.short_description: An hard draft with a scent of fusel oil. For those who simply want to get wasted

items.name: Alcohol
items.short_description: Almost pure alcohol, rare and quite expensive

items.name: Instant noodles
items.short_description: You can pour in hot water, or just eat it dry

items.name: Pasta
items.short_description: You can cook something with it, or just chew it as it is

items.name: Canned corn
items.short_description: Pretty tasty, sweet and nutritious

items.name: Ready-made lunch
items.short_description: An incomprehensible gray mass with even more incomprehensible bits of something, perhaps dried vegetables

items.name: Canned beans
items.short_description: Food rich in vegetable protein

items.name: Bread
items.short_description: Relatively fresh bread, baked no more than a week ago

items.name: Oats
items.short_description: You can eat it as is, but it`s better when cooked

items.name: Chips
items.short_description: Pre-war potato chips with the taste of spicy horseradish

items.name: Squirrel bits
items.short_description: Crackers with the taste of sorrel, so dry that one could use them to make sparks for a bonfire

items.name: Nuts
items.short_description: A mixture of nuts in a bag, who knows how preserved from pre-war times

items.name: Sugar bombs
items.short_description: Sweet corn flakes shaped like air bombs

items.name: Lollipops
items.short_description: Pre-war delicacy, delicious sweet and sour sweets

items.name: Dried bananas
items.short_description: Delicacy from the land of zebras

items.name: Halva
items.short_description: Sweet mass made of ground peanuts

items.name: Honey
items.short_description: Honey can be stored for hundreds of years, but fresh honey is lost, probably, forever

items.name: Apple
items.short_description: A real apple grown on the surface

items.name: Carrot
items.short_description: Sweet and crisp root

items.name: Onion
items.short_description: Bitter vegetable, used in many dishes

items.name: Tomato
items.short_description: Delicious vegetable of a slightly sour taste

items.name: Cucumber
items.short_description: Green watery vegetable

items.name: Cabbage
items.short_description: Juicy and fibrous vegetable

items.name: Butter
items.short_description: Fresh butter from a local farm

items.name: Cheese
items.short_description: Fresh cheese, looks and smells good

items.name: Egg
items.short_description: Looks more like an egg of some reptile than bird

items.name: Meat
items.short_description: It is not recommended to eat raw meat

items.name: Cave Mushroom
items.short_description: Mushroom of questionable edibility

items.name: Potato
items.short_description: Nutritious tubers, usually used in cooked form

items.name: Flour
items.short_description: The main ingredient of any pastry

items.name: Garlic
items.short_description: A very spicy and odorous vegetable, used as a seasoning and as a chemical weapon

items.name: Sugar
items.short_description: Sugar is no longer produced, so its strategic reserves are very valuable

items.name: Ketchup
items.short_description: Tomato sauce with many spices and preservatives

items.name: Roasted meat
items.short_description: It is said that meat increases aggression

items.name: Cucumber sandwich
items.short_description: Simple snack

items.name: Fried potatoes
items.short_description: Simple yet delicious dinner

items.name: Oatmeal
items.short_description: Simple but nutritious and healthy food

items.name: Vegetable salad
items.short_description: It is important not to simply cut and mix vegetables, but to do it in a correct order

items.name: Pasta with cheese
items.short_description: Very nourishing and delicious lunch

items.name: Wasteland omelet
items.short_description: The traditional food of Wasteland wanderers. Any eggs are suitable for making it

items.name: Cheese sandwiches
items.short_description: Common humble breakfast

items.name: Caravan breakfast
items.short_description: The main principle of this dish is to mix everything in one pan and cook it

items.name: Soup
items.short_description: While this dish may look simple, its preparation has a lot of nuances

items.name: Pizza
items.short_description: By the Wasteland standards this is a rich dish

items.name: Casserole
items.short_description: A very tasty vegetable casserole with crispy cheese crust

items.name: Meat stew
items.short_description: This recipe was invented after the war, when meat began to be consumed in large quantities

items.name: Special salad
items.short_description: Mixing, at the first glance, incompatible ingredients, we get a completely unexpected taste

items.name: Cabbage pies
items.short_description: An old, well known in the past recipe for hoofmade pies

items.name: Muffins
items.short_description: Everypony`s favorite tea time pastries

items.name: Apple pie
items.short_description: Nowadays it is not so easy to get the right ingredients for the traditional apple pie. But it`s totally worth it

items.name: Meat pie
items.short_description: The filling of this pie consists of meat and vegetables. It is very nutritious, and if you eat it for breakfast, you are sated until evening

items.name: Spicy cake
items.short_description: A cake with a very strange filling, for true lovers of Wasteland culinary

items.name: Sweet pie
items.short_description: This pie includes almost everything sweet that can be found it the Wasteland. Extreme dose of sugar

items.name: Borscht
items.short_description: A type of soup of a very complex composition. Only an experienced chef can cook it properly

items.name: Distortion field
items.short_description: This spell surrounds you with a magic field that slows movements of any hostile objects. Improving "Magic" skill increases a radius of the field

items.name: Magical barrier
items.short_description: This spell enables you to summon a magical barrier in a specific location, absorbing enemy bullets and magical spells. The barrier has limited endurance and time of existence, after which it dissipates. Importantly, it lets your bullets and missiles come through

items.name: Kinetic blast
items.short_description: This spell releases all your telekinetic power in one mighty impulse. All enemies around you get knocked back with enormous force and might even get stunned. It is very useful when you are surrounded

items.name: Crystal shield
items.short_description: This spell creates a shell around you that looks like a crystal. It absorbs any external damage, consuming magical energy instead of health. To use it, hold down the spell key

items.name: Kinetic dash
items.short_description: This spell uses your telekinetic powers to give you a powerful directed impulse. Can be used for evading attacks in combat or getting to hard-to-reach places

items.name: Magical shield
items.short_description: This spell surrounds you with a protective field, increasing your armor stats. It protects from any external damage, however strong blows, armor-piercing bullets and explosions can overwhelm the shield and cause a somewhat reduced damage. It has limited endurance and existence time

items.name: Moonblade
items.short_description: The spell summons a spirit moonblade, fighting on your side

items.name: Ghost wall
items.short_description: Allows you to create a ghost wall impassable for your enemies. The wall has a certain limit of durability and lifetime. It is fully permeable for all inanimate objects, like bullets and shells, and for its creator. The wall cannot be created in doorways and on staircases

items.name: Blood shield
items.short_description: The spell uses some of your blood to create an impenetrable magic shield for a few seconds. It gives complete invulnerability to any external damage and can save you at the most critical moment at the cost of some blood loss. It won`t work if you don`t have enough blood

items.name: Pre-war bits
items.short_description: Pre-War bits, not widely used these days, but can be exchanged for caps

items.name: Emerald
items.short_description: Gems are still valued highly these days. You can sell it for a good price

items.name: Sapphire
items.short_description: Gems are still valued highly these days. You can sell it for a good price

items.name: Ruby
items.short_description: Gems are still valued highly these days. You can sell it for a good price

items.name: Data disc
items.short_description: Information downloaded from the terminal contains long forgotten secrets of the past. You can sell it for a good price

items.name: Disc with valuable data
items.short_description: Data on pre-war technologies is on high demand among certain communities

items.name: Pre-War book
items.short_description: Undamaged pre-war books - a true rarity nowadays. Most merchants will gladly pay for them

items.name: Cogwheel
items.short_description: Just a souvenir

items.name: The Cyberpony magazine
items.short_description: The magazine, issued before the War by a society that promoted the idea of turning ponies into cyborgs. It lasted only one year, after which it was banned for moral and ethical reasons

items.name: Armor blueprints
items.short_description: A pack of drawings for some unusual armor. Only specialists can understand them

items.name: Ice sapphire
items.short_description: A huge sapphire spreading a frosty aura

items.name: Fire ruby
items.short_description: A huge ruby shining with fiery light and radiating heat

items.name: Marine emerald
items.short_description: A huge emerald, for some reason always wet and smelling like the sea

items.name: Calipers
items.short_description: The device for precise measurements of size

items.name: Hydraulic bolt cutter
items.short_description: Can cut even a thick iron bar

items.name: Oscilloscope
items.short_description: A complex device for analyzing parameters of an electrical signal

items.name: Smuggled cigars
items.short_description: A box of cigars illegally imported from the zebra country. Excellent smokes

items.name: A pack of tobacco
items.short_description: Leaf tobacco for smoking pipes. Perfectly preserved, Smoky Pit will gladly pay for it

items.name: Smoking pipe
items.short_description: Excellent pipe of cherry wood. Smoky Pit will be glad to get it

items.name: Bong
items.short_description: A device for heavy smokers. Perhaps Smoky Pit will like it?

items.name: Glycerol canister
items.short_description: A plastic canister containing a clear viscous liquid. With the necessary knowledge you can turn it into explosive nitroglycerin

items.name: "Celestial Mechanics"
items.short_description: A book telling about movements of celestial bodies

items.name: Equidroid Data disc
items.short_description: This disk contains schematics, wiring diagrams and other information useful for figuring out how equidroids work. Although, frankly, it`s unlikely for one to be able to understand at least some of this without being a certified robotics engineer

items.name: Box of new screws
items.short_description: A whole box of brand-new bolts and screws of all sizes. A dream of any mechanic

items.name: Box of new nuts
items.short_description: A whole box of brand-new nuts and washers of all sizes. A dream of any mechanic

items.name: Apple cider "Old farm"
items.short_description: Cider of the highest quality with a delicate taste and aroma

items.name: Apple wine "Pink sunset"
items.short_description: Rare rose wine for real esthetes

items.name: Apple liquor "Summer flavors"
items.short_description: In addition to apples, the composition of this liqueur includes a dozen different kinds of fruits

items.name: Apple Whiskey "Wild Pegasus"
items.short_description: A popular brand of whiskey before the War, currently 200-year-old!

items.name: Apple vodka "Crystal"
items.short_description: Vodka of elite quality, worth a lot of money before the War. Purified with magic crystals!

items.name: Granny Smith`s Apple bitter
items.short_description: They say that over the passed time this tincture has acquired an absolutely unique taste

items.name: Apple balsam "The gift of nature"
items.short_description: "Healing" liqueur made from apples, 24 kinds of herbs and medical alcohol

items.name: Vaccine for the dust fever
items.short_description: The only known cure for this disease

items.name: Water talisman
items.short_description: A magical device that cleans water of chemical impurities, microbes and radiation

items.name: Balefire-battery
items.short_description: A compact device that uses Balefire technology to produce an almost unlimited amount of energy

items.name: Disc of the Min. of Image
items.short_description: This disc contains information about the development of the StealthBuck M2. Perhaps Steel Rangers will find it interesting

items.name: Secret documents of the Legion
items.short_description: The document is titled "ኽዤዌቇሕችነዥሚኆ፧" - whatever this means. Unfortunately, you don`t speak the zebra language and won`t be able to read this

items.name: Magnetic resonance horsgregator
items.short_description: Makes horsgregation using magnetic resonance - you don`t have to be a scientist to understand that

items.name: Ultra-quadruponificator
items.short_description: Much more powerful than common quadruponificator. A real breakthrough in a world of quadruponification!

items.name: Baryon neighralyzer
items.short_description: Neighralyzes whatever you want and any way you like - this device has so much better capabilities compared to its analogues

items.name: Superluminescent quasistabilitron
items.short_description: It can glow in different colors or rectify electric current - depending on the state of the quantum field

items.name: Hyperbeam twilifuser
items.short_description: The most important thing to remember when working with this device - where that plug goes into. Incorrect plugging may cause dire consequences

items.name: Enclave Power Armor
items.short_description: Power armor for pegasi. You will not be able to wear it properly without some modifications

items.name: Slavers` key
items.short_description: Opens various locks in the slavers` den

items.name: Security access key
items.short_description: Gives access to the ManeTec Department of Special Research

items.name: Overmare`s key
items.short_description: Gives access to the overmare office of stable 88

items.name: Alicorn key
items.short_description: The key taken from a very strong alicorn in Manehattan, the Blood Moon

items.name: Utility room key
items.short_description: Oak Stalwort`s key

items.name: Necromancer`s key
items.short_description: The key belonging to the necromancer zebra Mchawi

items.name: Steel Rangers` key
items.short_description: The key that was kept by Elder Coldsight

items.name: The extremely valuable key
items.short_description: The key to some cellar in Canterlot that, according to rumors, is full of treasures. At least you hope so, and that the key is worth it

items.name: Centurion Key
items.short_description: A key found at the Legion`s headquarters

items.name: Colonel`s Key
items.short_description: Key received from the commander of the Enclave base

items.name: StealthBuck
items.short_description: Portable techno-magical device developed by the Ministry of Arcane Sciences with support from the Ministry of Image, capable to make his owner invisible for a short period of time

items.name: Weapon repair kit
items.short_description: Can be used to repair almost any weapon. Using this, you can repair an equipped weapon by some degree depending on the weapon class and your repair skill

items.name: Burglar rune
items.short_description: The burglar rune can open any lock, even a stuck one. Single use. To activate, hover cursor over a door or container with a tough lock and press @1

items.name: Electronic lock pick
items.short_description: A single use device used to do a deep reboot of the terminal resetting all passwords. It was hard to get even before the War, not to mention now. To use, hover over a secure terminal and press @1

items.name: Rune of return
items.short_description: The rune of return teleports you to the base camp from anywhere (confirm action by pressing the button). You can return to the nearest MAS terminal. One-time use

items.name: Bobby pin
items.short_description: Pins are useful for lock picking. They are used to probe and move springs inside a lock with less risk of breaking and jamming it than if using brutal force. In case of failure, you might break the pin, but you will be able to try again using another one

items.name: Pulse bomb
items.short_description: Helps enter the Steel Rangers bunker. One-time use

items.name: A portable workbench
items.short_description: Using a portable bench you can repair your weapons and armor on a march, just like using a regular workbench

items.name: Demopony`s field kit
items.short_description: Contains all the necessary equipment for creating explosives on a march

items.name: Field lab
items.short_description: Contains all the necessary equipment for preparing potions and chemicals in the field

items.name: Whistle
items.short_description: Needed to call or dismiss a tamed phoenix

items.name: Robo-owl
items.short_description: A small security robot that can also serve as a personal assistant or secretary. Has a fairly powerful laser weapon. Can be used as a companion

items.name: "Fool" destiny card
items.short_description: Allows changing the game difficulty to "very easy" for a single time

items.name: "Hermit" destiny card
items.short_description: Allows changing the game difficulty to "easy" for a single time

items.name: "Mage" destiny card
items.short_description: Allows changing the game difficulty to "normal" for a single time

items.name: "Emperor" destiny card
items.short_description: Allows changing the game difficulty to "hard" for a single time

items.name: "Death" destiny card
items.short_description: Allows changing the game difficulty to "super-hard" for a single time

items.name: Screwdriver
items.short_description: Screwdriver is required for lock picking. You will also require pins. If you lack them, you can try to open the lock anyway, but the probability for the lock to get jammed will be much higher

items.name: Titanium screwdriver
items.short_description: A premium screwdriver made from the sturdiest titanium alloy should help unscrew even the most rusty bolts. You will also find it useful for opening locks, and your lockpicking skill will increase by #1

items.name: Stethoscope
items.short_description: A medical device designed to hear sounds coming from internal organs... or the sounds the lock makes during lockpicking. Increases your level of lockpicking by #1

items.name: Diamond whetstone
items.short_description: A very useful tool for sharpening weapons. Just always carry it with you and it will increase damage of your piercing and cutting weapons by #1

items.name: Binoculars
items.short_description: Old binoculars with scratched lenses, a gift from Calamity

items.name: Ammo pouch
items.short_description: A pouch made of thick tarpaulin of a special design by Brass Buckshot. With this you can carry more ammo, batteries or explosives without any loss of mobility

items.name: Large Ammo Pouch
items.short_description: A durable synthetic fabric pouch designed by Steel Rangers specialists. With this you can carry more ammo, batteries or explosives without constraining your movements

items.name: Subdermal Armor
items.short_description: A secret technology developed as a part of "Cyber-pony" project. Implant reinforces skin with polymer tissue, that raises damage threshold by #1. Implantation cost is included in retail price

items.name: Magic keeper
items.short_description: The implant created specifically for war mages. Never lets your magical power reach zero, protects from burnout

items.name: Regeneration module
items.short_description: A complex and expensive implant that combines advanced magic and nanotechnology. Automatically restores the user`s health by #1 units per second, without requiring additional resources, but no more than #2 of the maximum health

items.name: Logical processor
items.short_description: A small chip that connects directly to the brain. Improves memory, helps to do mathematical calculations, improves the accuracy of telekinesis. In general, this leads to an increase of Lockpicking skill by #1 and Science by #2

items.name: Metal detector
items.short_description: A simple device, connectable to PipBuck. Set for detection of small metal items, it allows you finding lost caps and ammo in the most unexpected places

items.name: Tactical analyzer
items.short_description: An advanced module for PipBuck, allows scanning enemies to define strong and weak points. In S.A.T.S. you will see exact information about your enemies` health and armor

items.name: Targeting module
items.short_description: A complex device, connectable to PipBuck. During battle defines enemies` weak points not covered by armor and marks them with a laser point. You have a chance to attack in the weak spot, completely ignoring any armor. The chance is higher when using rifles and pistols

items.name: Holographic module
items.short_description: A complex techno-magical module for PipBuck, employing illusion magic. Acts as an active camouflage system, making it harder detecting you. In battle it creates illusive noise, distracting enemy`s aim. Increases Stealth and evasion bonus by #1

items.name: Reanimation module
items.short_description: An addition to medical PipBuck module. It constantly monitors your health, automatically applying medical spells in mortal danger, allowing the owner to survive and keep conscience even when seriously wounded. However it takes a long time to recharge after each use

items.name: Hacker`s module
items.short_description: A complex module for PipBuck allowing you to partially automate the picking of a password. Increases your skill for hacking terminals by #1

items.name: Enhanced robo-owl laser
items.short_description: Improved laser for a robo-owl, increasing damage by about one third

items.name: Robo-owl active defense
items.short_description: Strengthened body for the robo-owl, increasing its survivability

items.name: Quantum cogitator
items.short_description: A small but very powerful processor. Currently connected to your PipBuck, which increases your level of lockpicking and terminal hacking by #1, as well as the number of APs in S.A.T.S. mode by #2

items.name: Transistor module
items.short_description: An extension module for PipBuck increasing its computing power. Increases your level of lockpicking and hacking by #1, as well as the amount of AP in S.A.T.S. by #2

items.name: Twilight Sparkle figurine
items.short_description: Be Smart! Increases damage from combat spells by #1, also increases the chance of successful lockpicking and terminal hacking

items.name: Applejack figurine
items.short_description: Be Strong! Increases damage from melee weapons by #1, damage from hoof attacks by #2, and health by #3

items.name: Fluttershy figurine
items.short_description: Be Pleasant! Reduces the prices of merchants by #1 and increases the effectiveness of healing potions by #2

items.name: Rarity figurine
items.short_description: Be Unwavering! Increases the damage threshold by #1, reduces consumption of stamina and magical power by #2

items.name: Pinkie Pie figurine
items.short_description: Awareness! It was under "E"! Increases accuracy and stealth by #1

items.name: Rainbow Dash figurine
items.short_description: Be Awesome! Increases damage of all firearms by #1, and the speed of running and swimming by #2

items.name: Alicorn Amulet
items.short_description: An ancient and mysterious relic, increasing the magical power of the owner but enslaving his mind. Under no circumstances should you wear this amulet around your neck! Although just laying in your bag, it still strengthens your battle spells by #1 and decreases magic consumption by #2

items.name: Black book
items.short_description: The ancient tome written by mighty zebra shamans and containing their forbidden knowledge. But it is not just the dark spells and terrible rituals described in the book that are of interest. The book itself is also an extraordinarily powerful artifact, protecting its owner from black magic and giving the ability to absorb the vital energy from enemies

items.name: Stellar talisman
items.short_description: A powerful talisman, which will serve only an experienced warrior. Increases damage from any weapon by #1

items.name: Lunar talisman
items.short_description: A powerful talisman possessing powers that only a true hero can handle. Increases damage from any weapon by #1

items.name: Solar talisman
items.short_description: A great talisman, giving its power only to the chosen ones. Increases damage from any weapon by #1

items.name: Ether talisman
items.short_description: A legendary talisman worthy of only the best of the best. Increases damage from any weapon by #1

items.name: Memory orb
items.short_description: This magical item contains recorded memories of other creatures. Using it brings you an additional skill point

items.name: Toaster repair
items.short_description: Despite its name, this book can tell you not only about fixing toasters, but actually about repairing anything - from household equipment to modern weapons

items.name: Medicine - is fun!
items.short_description: In this book you can find interesting and fun facts about medicine, first aid, treating wounds and even basics of surgery

items.name: Magical arts
items.short_description: One of many pre-war books, dedicated to unicorn magic. Far from being very clever and scientifically accurate, it still has colorful pictures and lots of practical advice

items.name: Breaking-in and infiltrating
items.short_description: This book has detailed and well-illustrated descriptions of locks of different types and much advice on how to break them. An author definitely must`ve had problems with the law

items.name: Young hacker
items.short_description: A children`s guide, in which author introduces young readers to the basics of information technology, and also shares different less known facts about terminals and other electronic systems

items.name: Fireworks for parties
items.short_description: A book sponsored by the Ministry of Morale. It contains guidelines for safe handling of explosive materials used in fireworks and some other devices

items.name: Ammo-nation
items.short_description: Monthly illustrated catalog of firearms. It has detailed information on latest technical achievements and fashion trends in this industry

items.name: Hack and slash
items.short_description: A book on history of melee weapons. From ancient spears and blades to modern magical energy swords

items.name: Magic guarding our Home
items.short_description: A book about the latest trends on everything concerning development and application of magical energy weapons. Although useful information is quite diluted with pompous speeches and propaganda

items.name: Become a shadow. Self-guide
items.short_description: A guide for beginner spies and scouts. Despite that the author was obviously a paranoid psycho, the book contains some useful information

items.name: Why pay more?
items.short_description: This book teaches how to communicate with traders of all sorts, how to barter and get discounts and also recognize some common tricks and ruses

items.name: Telekinesis for dummies
items.short_description: A guide for young unicorns, that is supposed to help them develop their telekinetic strength

items.name: The Wasteland Survival Guide
items.short_description: This book was written after the War. It tells about different dangers of the Wasteland and ways to deal with them. The author - Ditzy Doo

items.name: The mysterious power of alicorns
items.short_description: Although this book tells about true alicorns, such as the princess Celestia, the knowledge contained in it might help you against the Goddesses alicorns

items.name: Velvet Remedy diary
items.short_description: Contains many records of ghoul studies

items.name: Note
items.short_description: A piece of paper found on Butch, the head of the slavers` guards

items.name: Slaver`s notes
items.short_description: Belonged to Sharp Shooter, the leader of a slavers gang

items.name: Griffin`s note
items.short_description: A note found on one of the griffins in the prison camp

items.name: Dictionary of foul language
items.short_description: Dear Reader! If you hold this opus in your hooves, that means that you have decided to take the first step in mastering the subtle art of foul language. The ability to swear firmly and ornately is actually an important and essential part of intelligent speech, and there is absolutely nothing shameful in it if used properly. In most cases, simply adding a dirty word to your speech is not enough to impress audience and fully express your feelings, and many improve their skills of conveying emotions colorfully throughout entire life. Sadly, our dictionary will unlikely be enough to raise you to the level of real maestros of this art, because the truly masterful swearing should come intuitively and from your very heart. But thanks to this book, you can definitely get a starting point that will guide you in further improving your talents in this field

items.name: Reinforced fabric
items.short_description: Durable material made of several layers of thick fabric with interlayers of polymer fiber for better ballistic protection. Used for manufacturing light body armor

items.name: Radiation-resistant fabric
items.short_description: A material enriched with metallic fiber, able to reflect radiation

items.name: Rubberized fabric
items.short_description: A rubber-saturated material, impenetrable for liquid and gaseous substances. Protects well in the aggressive environment

items.name: Tanned leather
items.short_description: Firm pieces of chemically hardened leather, can be used to enhance and repair leather armor

items.name: Metal plate
items.short_description: Hard and shiny metal plate, that not just any bullet can break through. Can be used to repair and enhance metal armor

items.name: Armored plate
items.short_description: A plate made of ceramics and complex polymers. Very firm and light, it is used in a modern combat armor

items.name: Enchanted plate
items.short_description: A plate of indistinct material, greatly enhanced by magic. Used in a magic armor

items.name: Aramid fabric
items.short_description: Aramid is stronger than steel and five times lighter. A multilayer fabric of this material can stop a pistol bullet and is quite fireproof

items.name: Chitinous plate
items.short_description: A fragment of a thick and sturdy chitinous shell. With enough skill you can make a decent armor

items.name: Camouflage plate
items.short_description: A plate of composite materials with a special textured surface. Used to repair or improve scout armor

items.name: Power armor fragment
items.short_description: A fragment of one of the greatest achievements of equestrian science and technology. Perhaps, if you collect enough of these parts, you can build a complete set of armor

items.name: Weapon fragments
items.short_description: Different details that can be used for repair or assembly of new weapons

items.name: Leather belt
items.short_description: Still looks like new

items.name: Turpentine
items.short_description: Organic solvent, obtained from the resin of coniferous trees. Toxic and flammable

items.name: Industrial battery
items.short_description: A Spark-battery used for powering up machinery and equipment. Heavy and not very powerful, yet very long-lasting

items.name: Duct tape
items.short_description: Essential in any household

items.name: Wonderglue
items.short_description: Can glue anything to any surface of any material for good

items.name: Rubber band
items.short_description: Even after all those years it is still elastic

items.name: Spring
items.short_description: An elastic part of some device

items.name: Fan blade
items.short_description: A bit rusty, but quite sturdy and sharp

items.name: Lighter
items.short_description: Indispensable accessory of any smoker

items.name: Paint Gun
items.short_description: A mechanism for spraying paint

items.name: Piston compressor
items.short_description: A simple device for air compression

items.name: Electric motor
items.short_description: Electric motor from a broken circular saw

items.name: Pressure cooker
items.short_description: A hermetically sealed pan for cooking at high temperature

items.name: Manometer
items.short_description: A device, measuring pressure, equipped with a safety valve

items.name: Hellhound Claw
items.short_description: A particularly long and sharp claw once belonging to a large hellhound. You can use it to make a weapon or sell it for a good price

items.name: Harmony crystal
items.short_description: A blue crystal of irregular shape. Its purpose is unknown

items.name: Electronic elements
items.short_description: All sorts of transistors, resistors, diodes, microschemes and other parts

items.name: Multipurpose chip
items.short_description: Electronic chip, that can be reprogrammed using necessary equipment and skill

items.name: Impulse generator
items.short_description: A compact device for generating radio signals of certain frequency and amplitude

items.name: Ultrasonic scanner
items.short_description: Device for scanning surroundings using ultrasonic signals

items.name: Laser pointer
items.short_description: A low-power laser, that can be used in an automatic target designator

items.name: Photochromic crystal
items.short_description: Crystal of complex internal structure, refracting and modifying light

items.name: Medical talisman
items.short_description: A complex magical device, capable of supporting patient`s life even when he is one hoof in the grave. Can restart a stopped heart

items.name: Electromagnet
items.short_description: A very powerful one, can hold stuff 200 fold heavier than itself

items.name: Levitation talisman
items.short_description: A compact magical device, allowing holding small items in air

items.name: Focusing crystal
items.short_description: A large and very pure crystal, used in heavy magical energy machinery for focusing energy flows

items.name: Superconductor
items.short_description: It has zero electrical resistance

items.name: Capacitor
items.short_description: An element of high capacitance, capable of producing high discharge

items.name: Passwords database
items.short_description: A memory module containing 300,000 most used passwords. It can be used to create a device that would help hacking terminals

items.name: Robo-owl case
items.short_description: Just an empty case without any filling

items.name: Motivator RX-47
items.short_description: Block controlling movement of a robot

items.name: Empty bottle
items.short_description: An empty bottle of Sparkle-cola, or of some other beverage

items.name: Tin can
items.short_description: A container for canned food

items.name: Lunchbox
items.short_description: An ordinary lunchbox from "Stable-Tec"

items.name: Pink powder
items.short_description: A multipurpose remedy for every life situation, used in hundreds recipes

items.name: Scrap metal
items.short_description: Just a pile of metal parts, good for nothing

items.name: Detonator
items.short_description: A small detonator used in grenades

items.name: Sensor
items.short_description: A small sensory module, reacts on proximity of specified objects

items.name: Gunpowder
items.short_description: Ordinary gunpowder

items.name: Trinitrotoluene
items.short_description: A substance in shape of yellow crystals, a base for powerful explosives

items.name: Timer
items.short_description: A kitchen timer shaped as a half of an apple

items.name: Fan
items.short_description: Old desktop fan, long broken and non-functional

items.name: Lamp
items.short_description: Old desk lamp, long broken and non-functional

items.name: Coffee maker
items.short_description: Old coffee maker, long broken and non-functional

items.name: Poisonous gland
items.short_description: Full of very dangerous poison

items.name: Acidic goo
items.short_description: Can be obtained from acidic slime

items.name: Ghoul`s blood
items.short_description: A muddy brownish liquid, that substitutes ghouls blood

items.name: Radioactive goo
items.short_description: Glows in the dark with ominous poisonous-green light

items.name: Wing membrane
items.short_description: Wing membrane of a huge bloodwing

items.name: Vampire fang
items.short_description: A fang of a bloodwing, containing liquid, preventing blood from coagulating

items.name: Bloatsprite wing
items.short_description: Resembles an ordinary insect wing, but of enormous size

items.name: Bloatsprite eye
items.short_description: Faceted eye, sparkling with all colors of the rainbow

items.name: Rat liver
items.short_description: Eww gross!

items.name: Rat tail
items.short_description: Looks like a giant worm

items.name: Monster`s fat
items.short_description: In a desperate case can be a substitute for machine oil

items.name: Flame gland
items.short_description: Gives some creatures the ability to breathe fire. You can feel a powerful magic contained inside

items.name: Fish oil
items.short_description: Some ponies consider this smelly substance good for health

items.name: Magic dust
items.short_description: Crystallized magical essence

items.name: Pink slime
items.short_description: Slime which absorbed the concentrated Pink cloud

items.name: Dark soul
items.short_description: Ephemeral substance left after destruction of a necrosprites swarm

items.name: Horn of the Witch
items.short_description: A horn of a very strong Canterlot ghoul

items.name: Biogel
items.short_description: The substance used by Auto-Doc as an expendable material for treating injuries and wounds

items.name: Magical herbs
items.short_description: All sorts of plants having magical properties, necessary for most potions. It is hard to find them in the Wasteland, although some zebra earn their living by gathering these for sale

items.name: Taint extract
items.short_description: A substance of magical nature. On contact with a living material it causes horrible mutations, but in precisely selected doses and in combination with other reagents may cause advantageous alterations

items.name: Hydra`s blood
items.short_description: An incredibly potent magical reagent. When properly used, it helps to wake up hidden potential of the body

items.name: A liquid rainbow
items.short_description: Pretty versicolored liquid with a horrible taste. Has prominent magical properties

items.name: Star dust
items.short_description: Sparkling silvery dust, that might be found in places of meteorite landing

items.name: Moonstone
items.short_description: A rare opaque mineral of blue-white color. According to beliefs, it has a connection to ancient mystical forces

items.name: Fiery crystal
items.short_description: An orange crystal resembling a tongue of flame. And even warm to the touch

items.name: Absolute salt
items.short_description: Very rare alchemical reagent

items.name: Dark Shard
items.short_description: It appears to be materialized dark magic

items.name: Mysterious essence
items.short_description: Actually, nopony knows what it is exactly, but not a single really powerful potion is possible without it

items.name: Schematics for the Saw blade launcher
